name: Leviate
description: Turn, pan and zoom the models with your hand in front of the webcam or your phone: open hand turns, fist pans, pinch zooms. Free and open source.

reasons.camera: To see your hand: the hand is tracked inside the plugin and the video is never recorded or sent.
reasons.internet: Only for Use phone: the free PeerJS server and a STUN server of Google connect your phone as the camera. Nothing else goes out.
